hints.title: Two-Tier Overlap Tracking
hints.text: A triple booking occurs if the proposed interval intersects with any interval where two existing events already overlap.

hints.title: Maintaining Single and Double Bookings
hints.text: Maintain two lists: regular bookings and double-booked overlap intersections. For each new interval, verify it does not overlap with any double-booking.

hints.title: MyCalendarTwo Book Blueprint
hints.text: For (s, e) in overlaps: if max(start, s) < min(end, e), return False. Then for (s, e) in bookings: if max(start, s) < min(end, e), add intersection (max(start, s), min(end, e)) to overlaps. Finally add (start, end) to bookings.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Checking against O(N) overlaps and single bookings takes linear time per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tracking continuous point arrays up to 10^9 exceeds time and memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual list tracking stores only pairwise intersections to prevent triple bookings.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Explicitly tracking intersection segments without full coordinate sweep line.
